info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v1-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Retrieval API facilitates access to information about pets that have been adopted through the platform. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of adopted pets, including details such as species, breed, and adoption date. Typical consumers of this API include pet adoption organizations looking to track and showcase successful adoptions, as well as potential adopters seeking insights into past adoptions. This functionality supports transparency and facilitates better matchmaking for prospective pet owners.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about pets that have been adopted. It provides information such as the type of pet, breed, and adoption details, making it easier for potential adopters to understand the availability and history of adopted pets.
